description: Under --watch, a saved source reruns its dependents and every earlier uncommitted change: b.test.ts first (src/b.ts changed before the start), then a.test.ts and b.test.ts after src/a.ts is saved; c.test.ts never. Jest only.

watch.keepLines: ^(?:<CLEAR>$|Watch Usage| › |Active Filters:|Pattern Mode Usage| pattern ›|Ran all test suites|Test run was interrupted|No tests found|No failed test found|Press `|Run Jest without|Interactive (?:Test|Snapshot)|Pattern matches|Start typing|Tests:|Test Suites:|Snapshots:)
